address.missing: Type the store's address: shop.acme.io, or acme-merch.myshopify.com.

address.notShopify.message: {address} doesn't answer like a Shopify store. Use its myshopify.com address, from Shopify › Settings › Domains.
address.notShopify.note: address: what the person typed, such as acme-merch.com

address.notWoo: {address} doesn't answer like a WooCommerce store: its REST API isn't there. Check the address, and that WooCommerce is active.
address.blocked: {address} isn't an address ReputeCast may connect to.
store.connected: {name} is connected already. Open its page to change what syncs.
store.notFound: That store isn't connected to this workspace.
store.wrongStep: {name} isn't at that step of connecting any more. Open the dialog again.

store.unavailable.message: {platform} didn't answer. Try again in a few minutes.

store.rateLimited: {platform} is limiting requests. Try again in a minute: the sync slows down and carries on by itself.
keys.clientId: Paste the app's client ID, from its API credentials in Shopify.
keys.secretFormat: That isn't a client secret: Shopify's start with shpss_. Copy it from the app's API credentials.
keys.missing: Paste the app's client ID and secret first.
woo.keyFormat: Paste both parts of the REST API key: the consumer key (ck_…) and the consumer secret (cs_…).
woo.keyRefused: WooCommerce refused this key. Create a REST API key with Read/Write access in WooCommerce › Settings › Advanced › REST API, and paste both parts.
woo.readOnly: This key is read-only. Create one with Read/Write access: ReputeCast registers webhooks with it.
woo.notConnected: No WooCommerce store is connected at {address}. Connect it in Settings › Integrations first.
list.exists: A list named {name} exists already. Pick it, or rename it first.
list.unknown: Pick one of the workspace's lists.
disconnect.confirm: Type {name} to delete its store data.

flow.paused.message: {store} is disconnected. Reconnect it to resume.
flow.paused.note: The reason an automation shows when a store's disconnection paused it.

notify.disconnectedBody.message: {platform} revoked access on {date}{reason, select, uninstalled { (the app was uninstalled)} other {}}. {flows, plural, =0 {Orders placed since then are fetched when you reconnect.} one {# automation paused. Orders placed since then are fetched when you reconnect.} other {# automations paused. Orders placed since then are fetched when you reconnect.}}

notify.webhookBody: It was deleted in {platform} on {date}. ReputeCast polls every 15 minutes until it's registered again, so nothing is missed.

consent.label.note: A consent record's source, on the contact profile.
